6.title: Earn a Bonus: use an if boundary
6.description: Implement `practicePoints(score)`: add 10 points when the score is 80 or higher, otherwise return the original score. The score of exactly 80 earns the bonus.
6.learningObjective: Use an if statement to add a bonus at an inclusive score threshold while preserving lower scores.
instructions: Start with the original score as the result.
Use if with the inclusive comparison score >= 80.
Return the adjusted result and check both 79 and 80.

workedExample.explanation: An if statement runs its body only when the condition is true. Keeping the unmodified score as the default handles every score below the threshold.

6.hint: The threshold includes 80, so use >= rather than >.
